create_AZLearner: create an AlphaZero-style MCTS learner with a Sonnet network, optimizer, and TensorFlow dataset
run_AZLearner_step: run a single SGD training step on the AZLearner and log the loss to the terminal
get_AZLearner_variables: get the trainable variables from the AZLearner network as numpy arrays for actor updates
review_AZLearner_loss: review the AZLearner value loss and policy loss computation using TD learning and cross entropy
build_AZLearner_dataset: build a TensorFlow dataset with transitions containing observations, rewards, discounts, and MCTS policies for the AZLearner
